specialist_trace.rationale: To ensure accurate coding, the documentation must specify the severity of the bleeding episode (e.g., massive vs. moderate) and the patient’s hemodynamic status (e.g., shock, transfusion requirement) to reflect resource intensity. Additionally, clarify the current status of cirrhosis (e.g., decompensated with ascites, encephalopathy, or jaundice) and the Child-Pugh class, as well as the anatomical site and grade of the esophageal varices (e.g., lower third, grade III) to capture the full clinical complexity. Finally, document the number of bands placed and whether ligation was complete or incomplete, as this procedural detail impacts coding for the intervention and residual bleeding risk.
